research_question: When does conservative spherical-cap block pruning beat a contiguous BLAS scan for exact cosine top-k on a single CPU thread?
hypothesis: Tight separated clusters permit substantial pruning; isotropic high-dimensional vectors and small databases can be slower due to loose caps and dispatch overhead.
measurement: Each mode gets the same single-query API, k, float64 vectors, thread count, and queries. Randomize mode and query order per repetition. Timer includes input validation, normalization, bounds, vector scoring, top-k, and result allocation, excludes data generation/build/load. Build, load, serialization and first call recorded separately. Report median and IQR over all query samples and per-repeat medians; no tail-latency claim. All valid samples retained.
